About sVn Business

Simplifying Business. Empowering Growth.

Many small businesses still keep sales in notebooks and chats. Money owed gets forgotten, expenses go unrecorded, and it is hard to tell whether the business is really making a profit.

sVn Business is a business management platform that brings sales, orders, customers, products, expenses, payments and business insights into one place, so running a business becomes simpler, smarter and more organised.

We believe every business, whatever its size, deserves simple and effective tools to manage its daily operations.

Our mission

To make business management more accessible, convenient and efficient for everyone.

Our vision

To build technology that empowers businesses to grow, adapt and succeed in an increasingly digital world.

Who we are

sVn Business is an independent technology project built by a group of young developers in Nigeria, driven by creativity, innovation and a passion for solving everyday business challenges.

Our commitment

We are committed to continuously improving our platform, listening to our users and building tools that make a meaningful difference to businesses.

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers about sVn Business, plans and your data.

What does sVn Business do?
sVn Business is a business management app. You record sales, orders, customers, products and expenses in one place and see your revenue, profit and unpaid balances at a glance. It also includes invoices and receipts, sVn Share product catalogues and sVn Studio for promotional videos.
Who can use it?
Any business owner who wants simple tools to stay organised, from a small shop to a growing business. It works from your phone or in a browser, and Pro lets you run up to 6 businesses from one account.
What is the difference between Free and Pro?
Free covers sales, customers, products, orders, expenses, invoices and receipts, sVn Share catalogues and sVn Studio with 10 exports a month, for one business. Pro adds sales analytics on Home, category breakdown and period comparison, the Money Leak Detector, reports and CSV exports, up to 6 businesses, unlimited Workspace notes, your logo on invoices and receipts, and unlimited Studio exports.
How much is Pro and how do I pay?
Pro is ₦1,000 a month at the launch price through the end of 2026, and ₦2,500 a month from January 2027. Payment is handled securely by Paystack, each payment adds 30 days of Pro, and Pro activates automatically once the payment is verified. An annual plan is coming soon.
How do I get started?
Create a free account with your name, business name, phone and email, or continue with Google. New accounts include a 7-day free Pro trial. Then add your products and customers and record your first sale.
Is my business data safe?
Your data is stored securely with Google Firebase and is only available to your account. We do not sell your personal information, and card details are handled by Paystack, so we never see or store them. You can export your business data from your Profile at any time and delete a business’s data from Settings.
How do I contact support?
Use the Email support button in the Support section on this page, or open Settings, then Support, inside the app. The sVn Business team will help you.

We are here to help

Questions, feedback or need a hand getting set up? Send us an email and the sVn Business team will help.
